Identity.UUID.name: Identity.UUID
Identity.UUID.description: UUID v4 with automatic base62 encoding for client-facing APIs

Temporal.DateTime.name: Temporal.DateTime
Temporal.DateTime.description: ISO8601 datetime string. Epoch wire values keep this scalar and declare x-temporal-format (unix, unix_millis, unix_micros, unix_nanos) on the property; the unit is never guessed from digit count.

Chore.name: Chore
Chore.comment:
A chore anyone may take for themselves, and no one may give to another:
an Assignment that gives no setting.

ChoreSeatsOccupants.name: ChoreSeatsOccupants
ChoreSeatsOccupants.comment: One row per subject seated on the row, keyed by its number, the order they were seated in: the seat, the subject, and when and by whom it was seated. A leave or a displacement deletes its row; the subject a seat's fromField holds needs none.

fields.name: chore
fields.description: The Chore row the rows are of; deleting it deletes them.

fields.name: number
fields.description: The occupant's number on the row, one past the greatest when it was seated, in ten digits zero-padded so the key's order is theirs.

fields.name: subject
fields.description: The subject seated, a hyphenated UUID kept in base62.

fields.name: seatedAt
fields.description: When it was seated, in epoch milliseconds.

fields.name: seatedBy
fields.description: The subject of the caller who seated it: the subject itself, or the one who assigned it.

Problem.name: Problem
Problem.comment:
A problem one person works at a time (D104, D103's step 5): an
Assignment, whose seat a caller holding problems.take takes for itself
while it is free, and a caller holding problems.assign gives to another.
Only its assignee starts and finishes it.

fields.name: status
fields.description: The state the instance is in.

fields.name: statusEnteredAt
fields.description: When the status last changed, in epoch milliseconds: the create's time, then each transition's. Absent on an instance created before Workflow kept it, until its next transition.
